kb_notes: One author (L. Frank Baum), connected Oz series — mixed PDF / DOCX / TXT.
Upload all files from the mixed-formats folder before running eval.
must_any / kb_quote_hint are grounded in Project Gutenberg public-domain text (truncated corpus OK).
Create Fleet agent named exactly: Oz Series Assistant (or pass --agent).

cases.question: Who is Dorothy Gale and where is she from in the Oz books?
cases.expected_answer: Dorothy Gale is a little girl from Kansas who travels to the Land of Oz.
cases.kb_quote_hint: Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas

cases.question: According to Ozma of Oz, who becomes the Ruler of Oz?
cases.expected_answer: Ozma became the Ruler of Oz.
cases.kb_quote_hint: after she became the Ruler of Oz

cases.question: In Ozma of Oz, who are Tiktok and Billina?
cases.expected_answer: Tiktok is the machine man; Billina is the yellow hen (called 'real Ozzy' in the author's note).
cases.kb_quote_hint: Billina is REAL OZZY, Mr. Baum, and so are Tiktok and the Hungry Tiger.

cases.question: In The Emerald City of Oz, what did the Nome King lose and who took it?
cases.expected_answer: The Nome King lost his Magic Belt; Dorothy (with Ozma) carried it away.
cases.kb_quote_hint: I've lost my Magic Belt. A little girl named Dorothy, who was here with Ozma of Oz, stole my Belt

cases.question: Why can't the Nome King easily go to the Land of Oz to recover his belt?
cases.expected_answer: A deadly desert surrounds the fairy country that no one can cross.
cases.kb_quote_hint: there is a deadly desert all around that fairy country, which no one is able to cross

cases.question: Who is Kaliko in The Emerald City of Oz?
cases.expected_answer: Kaliko is the Nome King's Chief Steward.

cases.question: In The Scarecrow of Oz, who are Trot and Cap'n Bill?
cases.expected_answer: Trot is a little girl; Cap'n Bill is her faithful companion (with a wooden leg).
cases.kb_quote_hint: Trot and Cap'n Bill be admitted to the Land of Oz

cases.question: Which friend helps land Trot and Cap'n Bill in Oz in The Scarecrow of Oz?
cases.expected_answer: The Scarecrow helps bring them into the Land of Oz.
cases.kb_quote_hint: required the best efforts of our dear old friend, the Scarecrow

cases.question: What kingdom appears in The Scarecrow of Oz besides Oz?
cases.expected_answer: Jinxland is a kingdom in the story.

cases.question: In The Tin Woodman of Oz, what is Nick Chopper also known as?
cases.expected_answer: Nick Chopper is the Tin Woodman (Emperor of the Winkies).
cases.kb_quote_hint: the "pretty Munchkin girl" whom Nick Chopper was engaged to marry

cases.question: Who is Woot the Wanderer in The Tin Woodman of Oz?
cases.expected_answer: Woot the Wanderer is a boy who helps the Tin Woodman seek the Munchkin girl he once loved.
cases.kb_quote_hint: until Woot the Wanderer interested himself in the matter

cases.question: What happened to Nick Chopper before he became tin?
cases.expected_answer: The Wicked Witch enchanted his axe and he traded his flesh for tin.
cases.kb_quote_hint: before the Wicked Witch enchanted his axe and he traded his flesh for tin

cases.question: Who is the Emperor of the Winkies?
cases.expected_answer: The Tin Woodman of Oz is the Emperor of the Winkies.
cases.kb_quote_hint: The Emperor of the Winkies, who is the famous Tin Woodman of Oz

cases.question: Who wrote the Oz books in this knowledge base?
cases.expected_answer: L. Frank Baum.

cases.question: According to Ozma of Oz, which companions travel with Dorothy?
cases.expected_answer: Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, Tiktok, Cowardly Lion, Hungry Tiger, and the Yellow Hen among others.
cases.kb_quote_hint: the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion and the Hungry Tiger

cases.question: What city is central in The Emerald City of Oz?
cases.expected_answer: The Emerald City.
cases.kb_quote_hint: Title : The Emerald City of Oz

cases.question: Name three recurring friends of Dorothy across the Oz series.
cases.expected_answer: Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion (also Ozma in later books).
cases.kb_quote_hint: Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, and about the Cowardly Lion, and Ozma

cases.question: In The Scarecrow of Oz, who is Button-Bright?
cases.expected_answer: Button-Bright is a boy character who gets lost and found again in the story.
cases.kb_quote_hint: Button-Bright is Lost, and Found Again

cases.question: What is the weather in the Emerald City tomorrow?
cases.expected_answer: Not in the KB — must refuse.

cases.question: Who plays Dorothy in the 1939 MGM Wizard of Oz movie?
cases.expected_answer: Movie cast is outside this book corpus — must refuse.
